meta.defaultTitle: First Canadian O.M-LTD (FCOM) — Civil, Infrastructure & Building Contractor since 1988
meta.defaultDescription: FCOM is a civil, infrastructure and building contractor established in 1988, delivering dams, mountain roads and buildings across Yemen and the Middle East, with offices in Yemen, UAE, KSA and Canada.

home.title: Civil, Infrastructure & Building Contractor since 1988
home.description: Dams, mountain roads and buildings across Yemen and the Middle East. 12 dam, 13 road and 15 building projects, backed by our own crushers, asphalt and concrete plants.

about.title: About FCOM
about.description: Established in 1988. Our mission, vision, core values and management systems: HSE, environmental, ESHS, QA/QC, sustainability and BIM.

services.title: Services & Sectors
services.description: Procurement, detailed engineering, construction, construction management, facilities management, O&M and BIM, across buildings, water, dams, ports, transportation and power.

projects.title: Executed Projects
projects.description: Roads, dams and buildings executed by FCOM, with an interactive map of Yemen, survey coordinates and a sortable table view.

equipment.title: Equipment & Plant Capacity
equipment.description: 234 equipment, plant and laboratory units across 36 categories, including 300 and 250 t/h crushers, a 180 t/h asphalt plant and 120 and 90 m³/h concrete plants.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: Offices in Aden (HQ), Dubai, KSA and Oakville, Canada. Email global@fc-om.com.
